title: Invoice never created
description: Contract C-1042 ($48,000 ARR) executed 2026-03-14. Workato recipe cpq-to-stripe-prod was paused during a Stripe API key rotation on 2026-03-12 and never resumed. Invoice never created. The customer has been using the product for 77 days without being billed.
fix:
1. Go to Workato → Recipes → cpq-to-stripe-prod
2. Resume the recipe
3. Manually trigger the "Contract Executed" event for C-1042
4. Confirm invoice INV-xxxx appears in Stripe within 5 minutes
5. Add a recipe health-check alert: notify #rev-ops-alerts if recipe is paused for > 24 hours

title: Invoice billed at wrong amount
system_owner: Zapier Zap: CPQ Quote Accepted → Stripe Invoice
description: Quote Q-889 was approved at $26,400. Invoice INV-2201 was created at $24,000 — a $2,400 (9.1%) delta. Root cause: the discount approval workflow in Salesforce CPQ ran after the Stripe invoice trigger had already fired, updating the quote amount retroactively without re-triggering billing.
fix:
1. Add a 10-minute delay after "Quote Accepted" before triggering the Stripe invoice — allows discount approvals to resolve first
2. For INV-2201: issue a corrective invoice for $2,400 to Orion Payments, Inc. and confirm payment
3. Audit the last 90 days of invoices for amount deltas > 2% against their upstream quote (this rule catches the population)

title: Renewal date gap — 14-day subscription lapse
description: Contract C-1019 term ends 2026-07-01. Renewal REN-441 is dated 2026-07-15 — a 14-day gap. The billing schedule was set up from the renewal date, not the contract end date. The customer has a 2-week window where their subscription is technically expired but their access is still live.
fix:
1. Update REN-441 renewal_date from 2026-07-15 to 2026-07-01 in Salesforce
2. Recalculate the billing schedule from the corrected renewal date
3. Add a validation rule: renewal_date must equal or precede contract term_end
4. Audit all open renewals for similar date gaps

title: Duplicate approved quotes — no contract for either
description: Quote Q-912 ($18,500 ARR, Approved) has no downstream contract. Opportunity OPP-7731 was marked Closed Won 47 days ago. Sales rep created a second quote Q-913 to fix a discount and forgot to close the first. Both are 'Approved' in CPQ. CLM has no contract for either.
fix:
1. Identify the correct quote (Q-912 or Q-913) with the sales rep
2. Void the incorrect quote in CPQ
3. Send the correct quote to Ironclad to initiate contract execution
4. Add a CPQ validation: only one quote per opportunity can be in Approved status

title: Currency mismatch — CAD invoice on USD quote
description: Quote Q-844 denominated in USD ($31,200). Invoice INV-2189 denominated in CAD — no FX conversion recorded. The Canadian entity was set up mid-deal after the quote was approved. Billing picked up the entity's default currency without reconciling against the quote.
fix:
1. Issue a corrective invoice in USD for $31,200 to Parabola Works
2. Void INV-2189 (CAD)
3. Update the Stripe customer entity to enforce USD billing for this account
4. Add a pre-invoice check: invoice currency must match quote currency

title: Renewal owner null — $96k at risk in 15 days
description: Renewal REN-457 expires 2026-06-14 (15 days). owner_id is null. Original CSM departed 2026-04-01; territory was redistributed but the renewal record was never reassigned. No one has called the account.
fix:
1. Assign REN-457 to the new territory owner immediately in Salesforce
2. Schedule a call with Sable Collective this week — 15 days is tight
3. Add a SFDC workflow rule: if renewal owner_id is null and days_until_renewal < 30, alert #csm-ops
4. Audit all renewals for null owner within the next 60 days
